LanguageData.RC_CommandBoardDesc: See which delivery jobs {0} is offering to couriers. Jobs are picked to fit this caravan's capacity, speed and means of transport. New jobs are posted between visits.
LanguageData.RC_Board_NoCapacity: This caravan has no room left for cargo.
LanguageData.RC_Board_NoDestinations: No friendly or neutral settlement is within reach of this caravan.
LanguageData.RC_Board_NoCargo: This settlement has nothing to ship right now.
LanguageData.RC_Board_NoFeasible: No delivery job this caravan could complete in time.
LanguageData.RC_Board_ComeBackLater: No more jobs for now. New jobs are posted between visits: leave and come back later.
LanguageData.RC_EmpireRequiresTitle: The Empire only hires couriers of standing: this caravan needs a colonist with the title of {0} or higher in {1}.
LanguageData.RC_OfferFoodWarning: Not enough food for the trip
LanguageData.RC_Accept_NotHere: The caravan is no longer at this settlement.
LanguageData.RC_Accept_Taken: Someone has already taken this job.

LanguageData.RC_Accept_TooHeavy: Too heavy: the cargo weighs {0} but the caravan can only take {1} more.
LanguageData.RC_TipSealed: The goods travel in a sealed, refrigerated crate: they cannot be eaten, burned as fuel or sold by accident, and they do not spoil.
LanguageData.RC_TipFailure: Failure costs goodwill with the sender: {0} if you break the seal or miss the deadline, {1} if the cargo is destroyed.
LanguageData.RC_StatusReturning: Return to any settlement of {0} within {1}
LanguageData.RC_CommandDeliverDesc: Hand the sealed crate over to {0} and collect the payment: {1}.
LanguageData.RC_CommandReturnDesc: The delivery could not be completed. Hand the sealed crate back to {0}: no payment, no penalty.
LanguageData.RC_CommandBreakSealDesc: Emergency use of the cargo. The goods become yours to use, but the delivery contract fails immediately.
LanguageData.RC_ConfirmBreakSeal: Break the seal on {0}?\n\nThe contract with {1} fails immediately and you lose {2} goodwill with them. This cannot be undone.
LanguageData.RC_ConfirmBreakSealNoContract: Open this crate of {0}? It is no longer bound to a delivery contract.
LanguageData.RC_QuestDescription:
{1}

{0} has hired you as their courier.

Cargo: {2} ({3}, worth {4}), sealed in a refrigerated courier crate.
Destination: {5} ({6}).
Payment on delivery: {7}.

Take the crate to {5} and use the "Deliver" command there. If the seal is broken or the deadline passes, the contract fails and {0} will be displeased (up to -{8} goodwill).
LanguageData.RC_QuestDescriptionReturning: Update: the delivery can no longer be completed. Return the sealed crate to any settlement of {0} to close the contract without a penalty.
LanguageData.RC_Story_OtherFaction: {0} is sending {1} to {2}, a settlement of {3}, {4}.
LanguageData.RC_Story_SameFaction: {0} is sending {1} to {2}, one of their own settlements, {4}.
LanguageData.RC_Story_DefaultClause: as part of a regular shipment
LanguageData.RC_LetterAcceptedText:
{1}

{0} took the job.

Cargo: {2} ({3}), in a sealed crate.
Deliver to: {4} ({5}).
Deadline: {6} (estimated travel time: {7}).
Payment on delivery: {8}.

The destination is marked in the Quests tab. Break the seal only in an emergency: the contract would fail.
LanguageData.RC_LetterReturnedText: {0} was returned to {1}. The contract is closed with no penalty.
LanguageData.RC_LetterVoidedText: The courier contract for {0} is void: {1} no longer exists, so there is nobody left to deliver for. The crate is yours to keep or open.
LanguageData.RC_LetterClientHostileDeliver: {0} is now hostile to you, but the courier contract for {1} still stands.\n\nYou can still deliver the crate to {2} ({3}) within {5} and collect the payment. If the seal is broken or the deadline passes, the contract fails and relations with {0} get worse (-{4} goodwill).
LanguageData.RC_LetterClientHostileWait: {0} is now hostile to you, but the courier contract for {1} still stands.\n\n{2} belongs to {0} too: you can only deliver the crate if relations improve within {5}. If the seal is broken or the deadline passes, the contract fails and relations with {0} get worse (-{4} goodwill).
LanguageData.RC_LetterClientHostileReturn: {0} is now hostile to you, but they still expect their cargo back ({1}).\n\nYou can only return the crate to one of their settlements if relations improve within {5}. If the seal is broken or the deadline passes, the contract fails and relations with {0} get worse (-{4} goodwill).
LanguageData.RC_LetterFailedText: The delivery of {0} for {1} has failed: {2}\n\nGoodwill with {1}: -{3}.
LanguageData.RC_FailReason_Expired: the deadline passed before the cargo was delivered.
LanguageData.RC_FailReason_SealBroken: the seal on the crate was broken.
LanguageData.RC_FailReason_CargoLost: the crate was lost or destroyed.
LanguageData.RC_FailReason_NotReturned: the cargo was not returned in time.
LanguageData.RC_LetterReturnText: The delivery of {0} to {1} cannot be completed: {2}\n\nReturn the sealed crate to any settlement of {3} within {4} to close the contract without a penalty.
LanguageData.RC_LetterReturnHostileText: The delivery of {0} to {1} cannot be completed: {2}\n\nThe cargo must go back to {3}, but they are hostile to you: you can only return it to one of their settlements if relations improve within {4}. If the seal is broken or the deadline passes, the contract fails and relations with {3} get worse (-{5} goodwill).
